# Writing your own functions

See: https://odsti.github.io/cfd-textbook/introducing_functions.html

```{python}
import numpy as np
```

```{python}
np.repeat('GLOBAL ACADEMY', 12)
```

```{python}
np.sqrt(100)
```

```{python}
(10 * 10)/10 == np.sqrt(100)
```

[Talk about keywords]

```{python}
def print_my_name(name):
    
    return name
```

```{python}
print_my_name("Pete")
```
